notes.title: Added free DLC---增加了免费DLC
notes.notes:
Since it is my first time to do game DLC, I do not know whether this DLC will load normally, so I choose to let you download this DLC for free. There are 100 cats and two new scenes in this DLC, and you can get it according to the normal DLC downloading process. If anyone can't load the DLC, send me an email at 710066603@qq.com.
     由于我第一次做游戏DLC，我并不知道这个DLC是否会正常的加载，所以我选择免费让大家下载这个DLC，这个DLC里有一百只猫，两张全新的场景，大家可以按照正常的下载DLC的流程去获得它，如果有人无法加载DLC可以给我发邮件【710066603@qq.com】或者在qq群：630871369   中反馈bug。

notes.title: Game window optimization游戏窗口优化
notes.notes:
Game window optimization: Directly maximize the window after opening the game, optimizing the problem of visual blind spots in the game level scene.
游戏窗口优化：打开游戏后直接最大化窗口，优化了游戏内关卡场景有视觉盲点的问题。
